resources.string: Use the same email and password as the web channel.
Sign in with fingerprint or face
Email or password don\'t match. Check them and try again.
We couldn\'t connect. Check your connection and try again.
We couldn\'t sign you in right now. Try again in a few minutes.
Sign-up happens on the web channel. Create your account there and come back to activate this phone.
Your session is active. Next step: activate this phone with a liveness check.
Your phone is linked to your account.
You can turn on fingerprint or face sign-in anytime in Profile and security.
Sign in without typing your password every time. Solventa never stores your fingerprint or face: your phone verifies them.
We couldn\'t turn on biometric sign-in. You can try later in Profile and security.
Your phone has no fingerprint or face set up
Set them up in your phone settings and turn this on later from Profile and security.
Confirm with your fingerprint or face
Use your fingerprint or face to open Solventa
Use your fingerprint or face to open your policies.
We didn\'t recognize your fingerprint or face
Clean the sensor and try again, or sign in with your password.
All 3 attempts failed. Meanwhile, you can sign in with your password.
We detected a change in your phone\'s biometrics
A fingerprint or face was added or removed. For security we turned off biometric sign-in. Sign in with your password to turn it back on.
Sign in with fingerprint or face
Use your phone\'s biometrics instead of your password.
Set up a fingerprint or face in your phone settings to turn this on.
Don\'t have an account yet? Sign up on the web
To activate this phone we\'ll take images of your face while you make a gesture (blink or turn your head) and check that you are a real person.
We only use these images to verify your identity and link this phone to your account. They are not stored on the phone and are discarded after verification.
I agree to the use of my biometric data for this verification.
We couldn\'t connect. Check your connection and try again.
We couldn\'t save your decision. Try again in a few minutes.
Without your consent we can\'t run the biometric check, so mobile access can\'t be activated this way.
We\'ll verify it\'s you with a liveness check. We\'ll ask for a simple gesture in front of the front camera.
Find good light, remove sunglasses or face masks and hold the phone at face level.
We need the camera for the liveness check.
This phone has no front camera, so we can\'t run the liveness check.
Place your face inside the oval
Center your face and look straight ahead
Only one person should be in front of the camera
Turn your head to the left
Turn your head to the right
You can now use Solventa on this phone.
Check the lighting and follow the on-screen instructions.
For your security, activation is blocked for 24 hours. If you need help, contact support.
Check your connection. This attempt doesn\'t count.
Try again in a few minutes. This attempt doesn\'t count.
Take your time and follow the instructions. This attempt doesn\'t count.
Try again with good light. This attempt doesn\'t count.
